reviews.comment: Fun lectures, fun assignments, and a "fun" final. One of the most interesting classes I've taken at A&M, but I think his exams are starting to go over the edge in terms of difficulty.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures and labs are great; reference lab slides and any provided videos for PAs. Exams are roughly decent. Study for lab activities as if preparing for exam FRQs. Many grading categories.

Overall good prof, but its hard to know what to expect on exams since most exam reviews are tailored to other professors. +2 grade points are given as extra credit if you attend every lab. You honestly learn more from TAs during lab than during the actual lecture. Manageable exams if you prepare really well. Don't procrastinate learning!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Sueda is a mid professor. He will read un-motivationally read from slides. Prepare for monotone lectures . The grade breakdown for this class is cooked, some 9+ categories you have to keep track of. Labs are largely not useful, but make sure to attend them as a +2 points on final grade can allow for a ~ -15 point decrease on an exam.

Sueda & his TA's labs made understanding the curriculum very straightforward. I personally got more mileage from the labs, TA office hours (in a similar manner to 120/121), & weekly reviews. The course is time consuming with a lot of coding, but use whatever resources you need and nothing should screw you over. No complaints, definitely recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Sueda had great lectures and went into good detail about the topics, and was clear. There are generally quizzes at the end of class that act as attendance. The lab was ok too. Exams were not bad, but multiple-choice can be tough. All other assignments were standard across sections and professors.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Caring

reviews.comment: He is a very chill and kind professor for CSCE 221. Required attendance quiz almost every class so you do need to show up. His lectures are fine, a little boring at times but the content gets across. Tests are written by all profs and TAs across the course so that isn't really a factor here.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Caring

reviews.comment:
All-time favorite CS class I've taken here. Awesome lectures (do go to class as notes are typically not uploaded), and the assignments were fun but challenging. Start on them early! You get 6 non-documentation late days.

Definitely take 441 with him!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Sueda is goated. Attendance not mandatory, but lecture notes aren't uploaded so go. 1 midterm that you can skip or choose not to get graded but the final is worth more. 6 projects, not as hard as other classes imo, 6 free extension days total w/o documentation. Very accessible on Campuswire and will guide you on what you are missing. Start early
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Sueda was overall a really great professor. A majority of his lectures were just him reading of slides but he would also use VScode to show examples which I found to be very helpful. There are quizzes at the end of every class that you get to do with your table. Overall I would recommend him for 221!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Sueda is very lenient. Attendance is mandatory as there are quizzes every lecture, but you can work in groups. TAs were very helpful. Some programming assignments are lengthy, but adequate time is given to complete them.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great Professor who always helped me out where he could, especially when I made a couple mistakes. Grading criteria was clear and programming assignments were straightforward, TAs were helpful, although lectures were a bit boring.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you had the choice between Sueda and Leyk, take Leyk. She'll at least give you points back on tests. Sueda just seems confused on the material and is all over the place with his explanations. In lectures, he literally reads the slides and still somehow makes mistakes when explaining things. It really seems like he was forced to teach this class
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Sueda is an incredibly kind and intelligent professor. I had a difficult semester while I was taking his class and he was so incredibly patient & caring when rescheduling exams, quizzes, etc. Not to mention he's brilliant, has clear grading criteria, and covers exactly what will be on the exam (he gives hints in class!). He is one of the best!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Sueda abstracts the difficult art of computer graphics in such an easy-to-understand way. The class was engaging, and I liked how it relied mostly on application-based homework projects rather than exams. Lots of chances for extra-credit. I highly recommend taking one of Dr. Sueda's classes in the future!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Tied for the best CS class I've taken here along with 430. His lectures were informative, detailed, and well structured. The projects were fun to work on, though they took time. He offers an absurd amount of extra credit and grades leniently. That combined with a simple final makes it really easy to make an A if you put in the time and effort.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is the best professor I have ever had. This class was not easy, but if you plan ahead and commit to it you will do well. Dr. Sueda is so kind and patient. I asked him many dumb questions and he just patiently guided me along. I learned a lot and it was the most fun class I've taken. I can't recommend him enough.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Inspirational--Caring

reviews.comment: The Computation Animation course was fantastic (do NOT take it unless you have taken CSCE 441; you will suffer if you do that). The lectures are so well-structured that you could practically learn the material from just the notes alone. The subject matter is a lot more math-heavy than 441, which gets a bit boring sometimes, but it's worth it.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Unless youre super interested in computer graphics just dont take it. This class took up about 95% of my time the semester I took it

Great professor, very well-organized class. Focuses on practical implementation instead of theory. Pro: you can transfer lectures directly to assignments, Con: you won't be exposed to a fully comprehensive set of graphics topics. Word of advice: refactor code often, don't let it turn into spaghetti. Projects often build on each other

reviews.comment: Graphics is going to be hard and is a super math-heavy set of topics- if you're really interested in fields like games then you will LOVE this class and Dr. Sueda teaches it really well on top of that. Definitely very helpful outside of class, he really understands and respects your limits as a student/someone learning the subject.

reviews.comment: I took CSCE 441 this spring (online due to COVID) and loved it. The lectures are engaging and Prof Sueda does a great job of explaining the concepts you need for the projects. The assignments are big and take a fair amount of time, but the requirements are clear and his office hours are super helpful. Would take this class again.

reviews.comment: Proffesor Sueda, is fantastic. I had him for both 441: Computer Graphics and 489 Computer Animation. Because of the pandemic both classes were graded entirely on the projects. The projects are exciting and interesting but they are quite time consuming. His lectures are great and quite engaging. He is a great professor and I highly recommend him!!!

reviews.comment: Professor Sueda is by far the best Professor I have had at A&M. He is extremely knowledgeable in the field of computer graphics and computer animation. I took both CSCE 441 and 489 with him and they were both amazing courses. The courses are very project heavy, although he gives you 5-6 late days that can be used as needed throughout the semester.

reviews.comment: Super nice professor and very knowledgeable. I took this class last spring with him and learned a lot. We had planned to have a midterm and final, but we ended up having only assignments counted and not doing the final after Covid. Great late day policy too.
